function monthsFromNow(m) {
  const d = new Date()
  d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + m)
  d.setDate(1)
  return d.toISOString()
}

function buildStudents() {
  return STUDENT_ROWS.map(([id, name, email, university, major, academicLevel, grad, gpa, gpaScale, skills, preferredCities, preferredTypes], i) => ({
    id,
    name,
    email,
    phone: `+966 5${(i % 9) + 1} ${100 + i * 7} ${4000 + i * 13}`,
    university,
    major,
    academicLevel,
    graduationDate: monthsFromNow(grad),
    gpa,
    gpaScale,
    skills,
    preferredCities,
    preferredTypes,
    bio:
      id === 's_nora'
        ? ''
        : `${academicLevel} ${major} student interested in hands-on training and real projects.`,
    // resume.status: 'analysed' | 'pending' | 'unreadable'
    resume:
      id === 's_new'
        ? null
        : {
            fileName: `${name.split(' ')[0]}_Resume.pdf`,
            dataUrl: null, // null means "use /sample-resume.pdf" in the viewer
            uploadedAt: daysFromNow(-20 + i),
            status: 'analysed',
          },
    notifyStatusUpdates: true,
    createdAt: daysFromNow(-55 + i * 3),
  }))
}

// ---------- accounts ----------
function buildAccounts(students, companies) {
  const studentAccounts = students.map((s) => ({
    id: s.id,
    role: ROLES.STUDENT,
    email: s.email,
    password: DEMO_PASSWORD_STUDENT,
    name: s.name,
    status:
      s.id === 's_new' ? ACCOUNT_STATUS.UNVERIFIED : s.id === 's_suspended' ? ACCOUNT_STATUS.SUSPENDED : ACCOUNT_STATUS.ACTIVE,
    suspendReason: s.id === 's_suspended' ? 'Posting misleading information in applications.' : '',
    failedAttempts: 0,
    lockedUntil: null,
    createdAt: s.createdAt,
  }))

  const statusFor = (id) => {
    if (['c_naseej', 'c_gulf', 'c_madar'].includes(id)) return ACCOUNT_STATUS.PENDING
    if (id === 'c_nova') return ACCOUNT_STATUS.REJECTED
    return ACCOUNT_STATUS.ACTIVE
  }

  const companyAccounts = companies.map((c, i) => ({
    id: c.id,
    role: ROLES.COMPANY,
    email: c.email,
    password: DEMO_PASSWORD_COMPANY,
    name: c.name,
    status: statusFor(c.id),
    rejectReason:
      c.id === 'c_nova'
        ? 'The CR number does not match the company name on the commercial register. Please check the details and resubmit.'
        : '',
    suspendReason: '',
    failedAttempts: 0,
    lockedUntil: null,
    createdAt: c.submittedAt ?? daysFromNow(-90 + i * 5),
  }))

  const admin = {
    id: 'a_admin',
    role: ROLES.ADMIN,
    email: 'admin@internconnect.sa',
    password: DEMO_PASSWORD_ADMIN,
    name: 'Abdulrahman Almalki',
    status: ACCOUNT_STATUS.ACTIVE,
    failedAttempts: 0,
    lockedUntil: null,
    createdAt: daysFromNow(-200),
  }

  return [...studentAccounts, ...companyAccounts, admin]
}

  const d = new Date()
  d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + m)
  d.setDate(1)

}

    skills,
    preferredCities,
    preferredTypes,

  const companyAccounts = companies.map((c, i) => ({
    id: c.id,
    role: ROLES.COMPANY,
    email: c.email,
    password: DEMO_PASSWORD_COMPANY,

  return [...studentAccounts, ...companyAccounts, admin]
}

function monthsFromNow(m) {
  const d = new Date()
  d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + m)
  d.setDate(1)
  return d.toISOString()
}

function buildAccounts(students, companies) {
  const studentAccounts = students.map((s) => ({
    id: s.id,
    role: ROLES.STUDENT,
    email: s.email,
    password: DEMO_PASSWORD_STUDENT,
    name: s.name,
    status:
      s.id === 's_new' ? ACCOUNT_STATUS.UNVERIFIED : s.id === 's_suspended' ? ACCOUNT_STATUS.SUSPENDED : ACCOUNT_STATUS.ACTIVE,
    suspendReason: s.id === 's_suspended' ? 'Posting misleading information in applications.' : '',
    failedAttempts: 0,
    lockedUntil: null,
    createdAt: s.createdAt,
  }))

  const statusFor = (id) => {
    if (['c_naseej', 'c_gulf', 'c_madar'].includes(id)) return ACCOUNT_STATUS.PENDING
    if (id === 'c_nova') return ACCOUNT_STATUS.REJECTED
    return ACCOUNT_STATUS.ACTIVE
  }

  const companyAccounts = companies.map((c, i) => ({
    id: c.id,
    role: ROLES.COMPANY,
    email: c.email,
    password: DEMO_PASSWORD_COMPANY,
    name: c.name,
    status: statusFor(c.id),
    rejectReason:
      c.id === 'c_nova'
        ? 'The CR number does not match the company name on the commercial register. Please check the details and resubmit.'
        : '',
    suspendReason: '',
    failedAttempts: 0,
    lockedUntil: null,
    createdAt: c.submittedAt ?? daysFromNow(-90 + i * 5),
  }))

  const admin = {
    id: 'a_admin',
    role: ROLES.ADMIN,
    email: 'admin@internconnect.sa',
    password: DEMO_PASSWORD_ADMIN,
    name: 'Abdulrahman Almalki',
    status: ACCOUNT_STATUS.ACTIVE,
    failedAttempts: 0,
    lockedUntil: null,
    createdAt: daysFromNow(-200),
  }

  return [...studentAccounts, ...companyAccounts, admin]
}

  const d = new Date()

  d.setDate(1)

}

import { useContext } from 'react'
import { StoreContext } from './storeContext'

/**
 * Access the data store from any component.
 *
 *   const { db, insert, update, remove, setCollection, transaction } = useStore()
 *
 *   db.listings                         -> array of all listings
 *   insert('saved', { id, ... })        -> adds a row at the top of a collection
 *   update('listings', id, { status })  -> merges fields into one row
 *   update('listings', id, (row) => ({ openings: row.openings + 1 }))
 *   remove('saved', id)                 -> deletes one row
 *   setCollection('shortlistTables', (rows) => rows.filter(...))
 *   transaction((db) => ({ ...db, a: ..., b: ... }))  -> change many collections at once
 *
 * Collections that don't exist yet are created automatically the first time you insert into them,
 * so a feature can add its own collection WITHOUT editing the store files.
 */
export function useStore() {
  const ctx = useContext(StoreContext)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useStore must be used inside <StoreProvider>')
  return ctx
}

/**
 * Read one collection. Returns [] if it doesn't exist yet.
 *   const listings = useCollection('listings')
 */
export function useCollection(name) {
  const { db } = useStore()
  return db[name] ?? []
}

/*
  All routes of the app. Owned by Musa (main branch).
  Teammates: you do NOT need to edit this file - your pages are already registered.
  Just replace the placeholder page files in your own feature folder.
*/
import { Navigate, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom'
import { ROLES } from '../lib/constants'
import ProtectedRoute from './ProtectedRoute'
import PublicLayout from '../components/layout/PublicLayout'
import AppLayout from '../components/layout/AppLayout'
import AuthLayout from '../components/layout/AuthLayout'

// guest + auth (Musa)
import LandingPage from '../features/guest/pages/LandingPage'
import ListingDetailPage from '../features/guest/pages/ListingDetailPage'
import NotFoundPage from '../features/guest/pages/NotFoundPage'
import SignupPage from '../features/auth/pages/SignupPage'
import LoginPage from '../features/auth/pages/LoginPage'
import ForgotPasswordPage from '../features/auth/pages/ForgotPasswordPage'
import ResetPasswordPage from '../features/auth/pages/ResetPasswordPage'
import CheckEmailPage from '../features/auth/pages/CheckEmailPage'
import VerifyEmailPage from '../features/auth/pages/VerifyEmailPage'
import CompanyPendingPage from '../features/auth/pages/CompanyPendingPage'

// student (Asim)
import StudentDashboardPage from '../features/student/pages/StudentDashboardPage'
import StudentProfilePage from '../features/student/pages/StudentProfilePage'
import SearchPage from '../features/student/pages/SearchPage'
import ApplyPage from '../features/student/pages/ApplyPage'
import SavedPage from '../features/student/pages/SavedPage'
import ApplicationsPage from '../features/student/pages/ApplicationsPage'
import SettingsPage from '../features/student/pages/SettingsPage'
import NotificationsPage from '../features/student/pages/NotificationsPage'

// company (Bahaa)
import CompanyDashboardPage from '../features/company/pages/CompanyDashboardPage'
import PostingsPage from '../features/company/pages/PostingsPage'
import PostingFormPage from '../features/company/pages/PostingFormPage'
import ApplicantsPage from '../features/company/pages/ApplicantsPage'
import AllApplicantsPage from '../features/company/pages/AllApplicantsPage'
import ApplicantDetailPage from '../features/company/pages/ApplicantDetailPage'
import CompanyProfilePage from '../features/company/pages/CompanyProfilePage'

// company shortlist + admin (Raed)
import ShortlistPage from '../features/company/shortlist/ShortlistPage'
import CompanyRequestsPage from '../features/admin/pages/CompanyRequestsPage'
import UsersPage from '../features/admin/pages/UsersPage'
import AdminPostingsPage from '../features/admin/pages/AdminPostingsPage'
import ImportedListingsPage from '../features/admin/pages/ImportedListingsPage'
import ExternalSourcesPage from '../features/admin/pages/ExternalSourcesPage'
import StatisticsPage from '../features/admin/pages/StatisticsPage'

export default function AppRoutes() {
  return (
    <Routes>
      {/* guest pages */}
      <Route element={<PublicLayout />}>
        <Route path="/" element={<LandingPage />} />
        <Route path="/listings/:id" element={<ListingDetailPage />} />
      </Route>

      {/* auth pages */}
      <Route element={<AuthLayout />}>
        <Route path="/signup" element={<SignupPage />} />
        <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
        <Route path="/forgot-password" element={<ForgotPasswordPage />} />
        <Route path="/reset-password/:token" element={<ResetPasswordPage />} />
        <Route path="/check-email/:accountId" element={<CheckEmailPage />} />
        <Route path="/verify-email/:accountId" element={<VerifyEmailPage />} />
      </Route>

      {/* student */}
      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute role={ROLES.STUDENT} />}>
        <Route element={<AppLayout />}>
          <Route path="/student" element={<StudentDashboardPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/profile" element={<StudentProfilePage />} />
          <Route path="/student/search" element={<SearchPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/apply/:listingId" element={<ApplyPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/saved" element={<SavedPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/applications" element={<ApplicationsPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/notifications" element={<NotificationsPage />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      {/* company waiting for approval (or rejected) */}
      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute role={ROLES.COMPANY} allowPendingCompany />}>
        <Route element={<AppLayout />}>
          <Route path="/company/pending" element={<CompanyPendingPage />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      {/* approved company */}
      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute role={ROLES.COMPANY} />}>
        <Route element={<AppLayout />}>
          <Route path="/company" element={<CompanyDashboardPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/postings" element={<PostingsPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/postings/new" element={<PostingFormPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/postings/:listingId/edit" element={<PostingFormPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/postings/:listingId/applicants" element={<ApplicantsPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/postings/:listingId/shortlist" element={<ShortlistPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/applicants" element={<AllApplicantsPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/applicants/:applicationId" element={<ApplicantDetailPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/profile" element={<CompanyProfilePage />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      {/* admin */}
      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute role={ROLES.ADMIN} />}>
        <Route element={<AppLayout />}>
          <Route path="/admin" element={<Navigate to="/admin/requests" replace />} />
          <Route path="/admin/requests" element={<CompanyRequestsPage />} />
          <Route path="/admin/users" element={<UsersPage />} />
          <Route path="/admin/postings" element={<AdminPostingsPage />} />
          <Route path="/admin/imports" element={<ImportedListingsPage />} />
          <Route path="/admin/sources" element={<ExternalSourcesPage />} />
          <Route path="/admin/statistics" element={<StatisticsPage />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      <Route element={<PublicLayout />}>
        <Route path="*" element={<NotFoundPage />} />
      </Route>
    </Routes>
  )
}

import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom'
import StoreProvider from './store/StoreProvider'
import AuthProvider from './context/AuthProvider'
import ToastProvider from './context/ToastProvider'
import AppRoutes from './routes/AppRoutes'

export default function App() {
  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <StoreProvider>
        <ToastProvider>
          <AuthProvider>
            <AppRoutes />

/*
  All routes of the app. Owned by Musa (main branch).
  Teammates: you do NOT need to edit this file - your pages are already registered.
  Just replace the placeholder page files in your own feature folder.
*/
import { Navigate, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom'
import { ROLES } from '../lib/constants'
import ProtectedRoute from './ProtectedRoute'
import PublicLayout from '../components/layout/PublicLayout'
import AppLayout from '../components/layout/AppLayout'
import AuthLayout from '../components/layout/AuthLayout'

// guest + auth (Musa)
import LandingPage from '../features/guest/pages/LandingPage'
import ListingDetailPage from '../features/guest/pages/ListingDetailPage'
import NotFoundPage from '../features/guest/pages/NotFoundPage'
import SignupPage from '../features/auth/pages/SignupPage'
import LoginPage from '../features/auth/pages/LoginPage'
import ForgotPasswordPage from '../features/auth/pages/ForgotPasswordPage'
import ResetPasswordPage from '../features/auth/pages/ResetPasswordPage'
import CheckEmailPage from '../features/auth/pages/CheckEmailPage'
import VerifyEmailPage from '../features/auth/pages/VerifyEmailPage'
import CompanyPendingPage from '../features/auth/pages/CompanyPendingPage'

// student (Asim)
import StudentDashboardPage from '../features/student/pages/StudentDashboardPage'
import StudentProfilePage from '../features/student/pages/StudentProfilePage'
import SearchPage from '../features/student/pages/SearchPage'
import ApplyPage from '../features/student/pages/ApplyPage'
import SavedPage from '../features/student/pages/SavedPage'
import ApplicationsPage from '../features/student/pages/ApplicationsPage'
import SettingsPage from '../features/student/pages/SettingsPage'
import NotificationsPage from '../features/student/pages/NotificationsPage'

// company (Bahaa)
import CompanyDashboardPage from '../features/company/pages/CompanyDashboardPage'
import PostingsPage from '../features/company/pages/PostingsPage'
import PostingFormPage from '../features/company/pages/PostingFormPage'
import ApplicantsPage from '../features/company/pages/ApplicantsPage'
import AllApplicantsPage from '../features/company/pages/AllApplicantsPage'
import ApplicantDetailPage from '../features/company/pages/ApplicantDetailPage'
import CompanyProfilePage from '../features/company/pages/CompanyProfilePage'

// company shortlist + admin (Raed)
import ShortlistPage from '../features/company/shortlist/ShortlistPage'
import CompanyRequestsPage from '../features/admin/pages/CompanyRequestsPage'
import UsersPage from '../features/admin/pages/UsersPage'
import AdminPostingsPage from '../features/admin/pages/AdminPostingsPage'
import ImportedListingsPage from '../features/admin/pages/ImportedListingsPage'
import ExternalSourcesPage from '../features/admin/pages/ExternalSourcesPage'
import StatisticsPage from '../features/admin/pages/StatisticsPage'

export default function AppRoutes() {
  return (
    <Routes>
      {/* guest pages */}
      <Route element={<PublicLayout />}>
        <Route path="/" element={<LandingPage />} />
        <Route path="/listings/:id" element={<ListingDetailPage />} />
      </Route>

      {/* auth pages */}
      <Route element={<AuthLayout />}>
        <Route path="/signup" element={<SignupPage />} />
        <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
        <Route path="/forgot-password" element={<ForgotPasswordPage />} />
        <Route path="/reset-password/:token" element={<ResetPasswordPage />} />
        <Route path="/check-email/:accountId" element={<CheckEmailPage />} />
        <Route path="/verify-email/:accountId" element={<VerifyEmailPage />} />
      </Route>

      {/* student */}
      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute role={ROLES.STUDENT} />}>
        <Route element={<AppLayout />}>
          <Route path="/student" element={<StudentDashboardPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/profile" element={<StudentProfilePage />} />
          <Route path="/student/search" element={<SearchPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/apply/:listingId" element={<ApplyPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/saved" element={<SavedPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/applications" element={<ApplicationsPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />
          <Route path="/student/notifications" element={<NotificationsPage />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      {/* company waiting for approval (or rejected) */}
      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute role={ROLES.COMPANY} allowPendingCompany />}>
        <Route element={<AppLayout />}>
          <Route path="/company/pending" element={<CompanyPendingPage />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      {/* approved company */}
      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute role={ROLES.COMPANY} />}>
        <Route element={<AppLayout />}>
          <Route path="/company" element={<CompanyDashboardPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/postings" element={<PostingsPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/postings/new" element={<PostingFormPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/postings/:listingId/edit" element={<PostingFormPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/postings/:listingId/applicants" element={<ApplicantsPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/postings/:listingId/shortlist" element={<ShortlistPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/applicants" element={<AllApplicantsPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/applicants/:applicationId" element={<ApplicantDetailPage />} />
          <Route path="/company/profile" element={<CompanyProfilePage />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      {/* admin */}
      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute role={ROLES.ADMIN} />}>
        <Route element={<AppLayout />}>
          <Route path="/admin" element={<Navigate to="/admin/requests" replace />} />
          <Route path="/admin/requests" element={<CompanyRequestsPage />} />
          <Route path="/admin/users" element={<UsersPage />} />
          <Route path="/admin/postings" element={<AdminPostingsPage />} />
          <Route path="/admin/imports" element={<ImportedListingsPage />} />
          <Route path="/admin/sources" element={<ExternalSourcesPage />} />
          <Route path="/admin/statistics" element={<StatisticsPage />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      <Route element={<PublicLayout />}>
        <Route path="*" element={<NotFoundPage />} />
      </Route>
    </Routes>
  )
}

import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom'
import StoreProvider from './store/StoreProvider'
import AuthProvider from './context/AuthProvider'
import ToastProvider from './context/ToastProvider'
import AppRoutes from './routes/AppRoutes'

export default function App() {
  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <StoreProvider>
        <ToastProvider>
          <AuthProvider>
            <AppRoutes />
          </AuthProvider>
        </ToastProvider>
      </StoreProvider>
    </BrowserRouter>
  )
}

# InternConnect - Front-End (Phase 4)

**The Ultimate Training & Co-op Platform.** One place for students in Saudi Arabia to find Co-op, internship and summer training, apply, and track every application. Companies post training roles and shortlist applicants; admins approve companies and moderate listings.

Team 14 · SWE 363-01 · KFUPM

This repository is the **React front-end prototype** for Milestone 4. There is no backend yet: all data is demo data stored in your browser (localStorage), so every screen and flow is fully interactive.

- Phase 3 annotated wireframes (Figma): https://www.figma.com/design/TTgWHwlEfcfQgtLAXtT716/InternConnect---Phase-3-Annotated-Wireframes?node-id=0-1
- Phase 3 clickable prototype (Figma Make): https://www.figma.com/make/Kq6KXCPbxBB8ZD8cK04Jdz/InternConnect-Desktop-Prototype

---

## Features

| Role | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| **Guest** | Browse and search open listings with typo-tolerant search and 7 filters, view listing details, get asked to log in when saving or applying. |
| **Student** | Dashboard with recommendations (Strong / Good match), profile with PDF resume, search, apply with screening questions, save listings with 2-day deadline reminders, track internal and external applications, withdraw / decline an offer, notifications and settings. |
| **Company** | Register (CR number + admin approval), company profile, create / edit / close / reopen postings with screening questions, view and review applicants, build shortlist tables by hand or with the chat assistant, approve a shortlist, export it (CSV / Excel) and finalize accepted applicants. |
| **Admin** | Approve or reject company requests, suspend / reactivate users, remove postings, review imported listings and duplicates, enable / disable the external source, view platform statistics. |

Automatic actions from Phase 3 (auto-closing postings at the deadline, deadline reminders, moving applicants to *Under Review*) run in the browser every minute while the app is open.

## Tech stack

- [React 19](https://react.dev/) + [Vite](https://vite.dev/)
- [React Router 7](https://reactrouter.com/) for pages and role-protected routes
- [Tailwind CSS 4](https://tailwindcss.com/) with design tokens taken from the Figma prototype (`src/index.css`)
- [lucide-react](https://lucide.dev/) icons, [Recharts](https://recharts.org/) for admin charts, [dnd-kit](https://dndkit.com/) for drag and drop in shortlist tables
- ESLint for code quality

## Getting started

**Requirements:** [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 18 or newer and npm.

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd SWE363_Project_Phase4_Frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:5173.

| Script | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run dev` | Start the development server with hot reload |
| `npm run build` | Build the production files into `dist/` |
| `npm run preview` | Serve the production build locally |
| `npm run lint` | Check the code with ESLint |

> **Tip (Windows / OneDrive):** if `npm run dev` crashes with `EPERM ... node_modules\.vite`, OneDrive is locking files. Delete `node_modules/.vite` and run it again, or keep the project outside a synced folder.

### Environment variables

None are needed for Phase 4. `.env.example` lists the variable the back-end phase will use. Copy it to `.env` when that happens; `.env` files are git-ignored and must never be committed.

## Demo accounts

The login page has buttons that fill these in for you.

| Role | Email | Password | What you'll see |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Student | `nora@iau.edu.sa` | `Student123` | Dashboard, applications in every status, saved listings |
| Company | `hr@aramcodigital.sa` | `Company123` | Open postings, a closed posting ready for shortlisting, an approved shortlist |
| Company (pending) | `admin@naseej.sa` | `Company123` | "Waiting for approval" page |
| Company (rejected) | `careers@novaretail.sa` | `Company123` | Rejection reason + resubmit form |
| Admin | `admin@internconnect.sa` | `Admin1234` | Admin console |
| Unverified student | `new.student@ksu.edu.sa` | `Student123` | "Verify your email first" message |
| Suspended student | `suspended@ksu.edu.sa` | `Student123` | "Your account has been suspended" message |

Entering a wrong password 5 times locks the account for 15 minutes (FR-A3). Use **Reset demo data** in the footer to start again.

## Usage examples

1. **Find and save a listing as a guest:** search `aramko` on the landing page (the typo still finds Aramco Digital), then click the bookmark: you are asked to log in or sign up, and after logging in you return to the same listing.
2. **Apply as a student:** log in as Nora, open *Data Analytics Intern*, click **Apply now**, answer the screening question and submit. The application appears in *Applications* as **Applied**.
3. **Shortlist as a company:** log in as Aramco Digital, open *AI Engineer Trainee* (closed) → **Applicants**, build a table by dragging applicants or ask the assistant ("make a table of the 5 strongest Python applicants"), then **Use as shortlist**.
4. **Approve a company as admin:** log in as admin, open *Requests*, open *Naseej Technology* and approve it. Logging in as `admin@naseej.sa` now opens the company dashboard.

## Project structure

```
src/
  components/
    ui/          shared building blocks (Button, Input, Modal, Table, Badge ...)
    layout/      Navbar, layouts, notification bell, account menu
    listings/    ListingCard, FilterBar, LoginPromptModal (used by guest + student pages)
  context/       AuthProvider (fake login) and ToastProvider
  data/          seed.js - the demo data
  features/      one folder per area, each owned by one team member
    guest/       landing, listing detail, 404                 (Musa)
    auth/        sign up, login, password reset, pending       (Musa)
    student/     dashboard, profile, search, apply, tracker... (Asim)
    company/     dashboard, postings, applicants, profile      (Bahaa)
    company/shortlist/  shortlist tables, assistant, export   (Raed)
    admin/       requests, users, postings, imports, stats     (Raed)
  hooks/         shared hooks (saved listings, notifications, filters)
  lib/           constants, validation, search, matching, formatting, export
  routes/        all routes, route guard and URL helpers (PATHS)
  store/         data store (localStorage), shared actions, selectors, system jobs
public/          favicon and a sample resume PDF
```

## Team

| Member | ID | Role | Front-end responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Musa ibn Rashid | 202437440 | Project Manager & Frontend Developer | Project setup, shared components, data store, routing, guest and auth screens, README |
| Asim Asiri | 202338490 | UI/UX Designer & QA Tester | Student screens (dashboard, profile, search, apply, saved, tracker, settings, notifications) |
| Bahaa Najjar | 202372990 | Backend Developer & API Specialist | Company screens (dashboard, postings, posting form, applicants, applicant detail, profile) |
| Raed Abumostafa | 202443380 | AI Integration & Database Admin | Shortlist tables + chat assistant, shortlist export / finalize, all admin screens |

How we work with branches and pull requests is described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). AI tool usage is declared in [AI_USAGE.md](AI_USAGE.md).

# Working on InternConnect

## Branches

| Branch | Owner | What goes there |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `main` | Musa | Shared foundation, guest + auth screens. Only Musa merges into `main`. |
| `asim` | Asim | Student screens |

| `raed` | Raed | Shortlist tables / assistant and admin screens |

Each member branch has a `RESPONSIBILITIES.md` file with the exact list of files, screens and checks for that member. Read it before you start.

## Rules that keep us free of merge conflicts

1. **Only edit files inside your own folder** (listed in your `RESPONSIBILITIES.md`). Your pages are already registered in `src/routes/AppRoutes.jsx`, so you never need to touch it.
2. **Never edit shared files**: `src/components/**`, `src/store/**`, `src/context/**`, `src/lib/**`, `src/hooks/**`, `src/routes/**`, `src/data/**`, `src/index.css`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json`. If you need a change there, message Musa and he will make it on `main`, then you pull it.
3. Need a small helper or component? Create it inside your own feature folder (for example `src/features/student/components/`).
4. Need to store new data? Use `insert('yourCollectionName', row)` from `useStore()`: new collections are created automatically, no store edits needed.
5. Don't run `npm install <package>`. Every package we need is already installed. Ask Musa if something is missing.

## Daily workflow

```bash
# first time
git clone <repository-url>
cd SWE363_Project_Phase4_Frontend
git checkout <your-branch>      # asim / bahaa / raed
npm install

# every time you start working
git pull origin main            # get the latest shared code from main
npm run dev

# when a piece of work is done
npm run lint                    # must show no errors
git add src/features/<your-folder>
git commit -m "add saved listings page"
git push origin <your-branch>
```

Commit small pieces often (one screen or one feature per commit) with your **own GitHub account**. Check `git config user.name` and `git config user.email` show your name before your first commit.

## Pull requests

1. On GitHub open **Pull requests → New pull request**, base `main`, compare `<your-branch>`.
2. Title: what the PR adds, e.g. `Student screens: saved listings and tracker`.
3. In the description, tick the checklist from your `RESPONSIBILITIES.md`.
4. Musa reviews and merges. If he asks for changes, push more commits to the same branch and the PR updates by itself.

# InternConnect - Front-End (Phase 4)

**The Ultimate Training & Co-op Platform.** One place for students in Saudi Arabia to find Co-op, internship and summer training, apply, and track every application. Companies post training roles and shortlist applicants; admins approve companies and moderate listings.

Team 14 · SWE 363-01 · KFUPM

This repository is the **React front-end prototype** for Milestone 4. There is no backend yet: all data is demo data stored in your browser (localStorage), so every screen and flow is fully interactive.

- Phase 3 annotated wireframes (Figma): https://www.figma.com/design/TTgWHwlEfcfQgtLAXtT716/InternConnect---Phase-3-Annotated-Wireframes?node-id=0-1
- Phase 3 clickable prototype (Figma Make): https://www.figma.com/make/Kq6KXCPbxBB8ZD8cK04Jdz/InternConnect-Desktop-Prototype

---

## Features

| Role | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| **Guest** | Browse and search open listings with typo-tolerant search and 7 filters, view listing details, get asked to log in when saving or applying. |
| **Student** | Dashboard with recommendations (Strong / Good match), profile with PDF resume, search, apply with screening questions, save listings with 2-day deadline reminders, track internal and external applications, withdraw / decline an offer, notifications and settings. |
| **Company** | Register (CR number + admin approval), company profile, create / edit / close / reopen postings with screening questions, view and review applicants, build shortlist tables by hand or with the chat assistant, approve a shortlist, export it (CSV / Excel) and finalize accepted applicants. |
| **Admin** | Approve or reject company requests, suspend / reactivate users, remove postings, review imported listings and duplicates, enable / disable the external source, view platform statistics. |

Automatic actions from Phase 3 (auto-closing postings at the deadline, deadline reminders, moving applicants to *Under Review*) run in the browser every minute while the app is open.

## Tech stack

- [React 19](https://react.dev/) + [Vite](https://vite.dev/)
- [React Router 7](https://reactrouter.com/) for pages and role-protected routes
- [Tailwind CSS 4](https://tailwindcss.com/) with design tokens taken from the Figma prototype (`src/index.css`)
- [lucide-react](https://lucide.dev/) icons, [Recharts](https://recharts.org/) for admin charts, [dnd-kit](https://dndkit.com/) for drag and drop in shortlist tables
- ESLint for code quality

## Getting started

**Requirements:** [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 18 or newer and npm.

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd SWE363_Project_Phase4_Frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:5173.

| Script | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run dev` | Start the development server with hot reload |
| `npm run build` | Build the production files into `dist/` |
| `npm run preview` | Serve the production build locally |
| `npm run lint` | Check the code with ESLint |

> **Tip (Windows / OneDrive):** if `npm run dev` crashes with `EPERM ... node_modules\.vite`, OneDrive is locking files. Delete `node_modules/.vite` and run it again, or keep the project outside a synced folder.

### Environment variables

None are needed for Phase 4. `.env.example` lists the variable the back-end phase will use. Copy it to `.env` when that happens; `.env` files are git-ignored and must never be committed.

## Demo accounts

The login page has buttons that fill these in for you.

| Role | Email | Password | What you'll see |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Student | `nora@iau.edu.sa` | `Student123` | Dashboard, applications in every status, saved listings |
| Company | `hr@aramcodigital.sa` | `Company123` | Open postings, a closed posting ready for shortlisting, an approved shortlist |
| Company (pending) | `admin@naseej.sa` | `Company123` | "Waiting for approval" page |
| Company (rejected) | `careers@novaretail.sa` | `Company123` | Rejection reason + resubmit form |
| Admin | `admin@internconnect.sa` | `Admin1234` | Admin console |
| Unverified student | `new.student@ksu.edu.sa` | `Student123` | "Verify your email first" message |
| Suspended student | `suspended@ksu.edu.sa` | `Student123` | "Your account has been suspended" message |

Entering a wrong password 5 times locks the account for 15 minutes (FR-A3). Use **Reset demo data** in the footer to start again.

## Usage examples

1. **Find and save a listing as a guest:** search `aramko` on the landing page (the typo still finds Aramco Digital), then click the bookmark: you are asked to log in or sign up, and after logging in you return to the same listing.
2. **Apply as a student:** log in as Nora, open *Data Analytics Intern*, click **Apply now**, answer the screening question and submit. The application appears in *Applications* as **Applied**.
3. **Shortlist as a company:** log in as Aramco Digital, open *AI Engineer Trainee* (closed) → **Applicants**, build a table by dragging applicants or ask the assistant ("make a table of the 5 strongest Python applicants"), then **Use as shortlist**.
4. **Approve a company as admin:** log in as admin, open *Requests*, open *Naseej Technology* and approve it. Logging in as `admin@naseej.sa` now opens the company dashboard.

## Project structure

```
src/
  components/
    ui/          shared building blocks (Button, Input, Modal, Table, Badge ...)
    layout/      Navbar, layouts, notification bell, account menu
    listings/    ListingCard, FilterBar, LoginPromptModal (used by guest + student pages)
  context/       AuthProvider (fake login) and ToastProvider
  data/          seed.js - the demo data
  features/      one folder per area, each owned by one team member
    guest/       landing, listing detail, 404                 (Musa)
    auth/        sign up, login, password reset, pending       (Musa)
    student/     dashboard, profile, search, apply, tracker... (Asim)
    company/     dashboard, postings, applicants, profile      (Bahaa)
    company/shortlist/  shortlist tables, assistant, export   (Raed)
    admin/       requests, users, postings, imports, stats     (Raed)
  hooks/         shared hooks (saved listings, notifications, filters)
  lib/           constants, validation, search, matching, formatting, export
  routes/        all routes, route guard and URL helpers (PATHS)
  store/         data store (localStorage), shared actions, selectors, system jobs
public/          favicon and a sample resume PDF
```

## Team

| Musa ibn Rashid | 202437440 | Project Manager & Frontend Developer | Project setup, shared components, data store, routing, guest and auth screens, README |

# Data model (demo data in the browser)

All data lives in one object (`db` from `useStore()`), one array per collection. The starting data is created by `src/data/seed.js`. Dates are ISO strings (`new Date().toISOString()`).

If you need a new collection (for example `assistantChats`), just `insert('assistantChats', row)`: it is created automatically.

## accounts
Login records for every role.
```js
{ id, role: 'student'|'company'|'admin', email, password, name,
  status: 'active'|'unverified'|'pending'|'rejected'|'suspended',
  rejectReason, suspendReason, failedAttempts, lockedUntil, createdAt, lastLoginAt }
```
`id` is the same as the student / company record id.

## students
```js
{ id, name, email, phone, university, major, academicLevel, graduationDate, gpa, gpaScale: 4|5,
  skills: [], preferredCities: [], preferredTypes: [], bio,
  resume: null | { fileName, dataUrl /* null = use /sample-resume.pdf */, uploadedAt, status: 'analysed'|'pending'|'unreadable' },
  notifyStatusUpdates: true, createdAt }
```

## companies
```js
{ id, name, crNumber, industry, city, email, contactPerson, phone, website, description, size,
  logo /* data URL or null */, submittedAt }
```
Approval status is on the matching **account** (`status: 'pending' | 'active' | 'rejected' | 'suspended'`).

## listings
Postings by companies (`source: 'internal'`) and imported ones (`source: 'external'`).
```js
{ id, source: 'internal'|'external', companyId /* internal */, companyName /* external */, externalUrl /* external */,
  title, summary, description, responsibilities: [], requirements: [], skills: [],
  trainingType, majors: [], academicLevels: [], city, workMode, durationWeeks,
  startDate, deadline, openings, paid: true|false, stipend: null|number,
  screeningQuestions: [{ id, text, type: 'text'|'yesno', required }],
  status: 'open'|'closed'|'removed', removedReason,
  postedAt, shortlistApprovedAt, finalizedAt }
```

## applications
Applications made through InternConnect.
```js
{ id, listingId, studentId, status /* APP_STATUS */, appliedAt,
  answers: { [questionId]: 'Yes' | 'No' | 'text' },
  history: [{ status, at, note }], external: false, archived /* optional, set when the student is suspended */ }
```
A student can apply only once per posting (even after withdrawing).

## externalApplications
Applications the student made on other websites and records by hand (FR-S9). Never updated automatically.
```js
{ id, studentId, company, title, link, appliedAt, status /* APP_STATUS */, notes, fromListingId /* or null */, history: [] }
```

## saved
```js
{ id, studentId, listingId, savedAt, reminder: true|false, reminderSentFor /* set by the reminder job */ }
```

## notifications
```js
{ id, userId, type: 'status'|'reminder'|'system', title, message, link /* a PATHS url or null */, read, createdAt }
```

## shortlistTables
Company shortlist tables (FR-C7). `applicationIds` hold application ids (not student ids).
```js
{ id, listingId, name, applicationIds: [], isShortlist: true|false, createdBy: 'company'|'assistant', createdAt,
  columns /* optional: which columns to show */, sortBy /* optional */ }
```

## assistantChats
Created by the shortlist assistant. Starts empty.
```js
{ id /* = listingId */, listingId, messages: [{ id, from: 'company'|'assistant', text, at, changes: [{ id, label, undo }] }] }
```
(`undo` should be data you can use to reverse the change, not a function, because the store is saved as JSON.)

## importedListings
Listings fetched from the external job API, waiting for admin review (FR-AD4).
```js
{ id, title, companyName, city, trainingType, majors: [], startDate, deadline, externalUrl, importedAt,
  status: 'new'|'published'|'rejected', duplicateOf /* listing id or null */ }
```

## externalSources
```js
{ id, name, status: 'enabled'|'disabled'|'error', lastSyncAt, imported, lastError, lastErrorAt }
```

## auditLog
```js
{ id, action, by, details, at }
```

## passwordResets
Used by the forgot-password flow only.
```js
{ id /* token */, accountId, expiresAt, used }
```

UI components - `src/components/ui` ```jsx import { Alert, Avatar, Badge, Button, Card, Checkbox, ConfirmDialog, Drawer, EmptyState, FileUpload, FormField, Input, Modal, PageHeader, Select, Spinner, StatCard, StatusBadge, Tabs, Textarea, Toggle, Table, Th, Td } from '../../../components/ui' ``` | Component | Use it for | Example | | --- | --- | --- | | `PageHeader` | Top of every page (eyebrow + serif title + subtitle + buttons) | `..} />` | | `Button` | All buttons and button-looking links | `` · `` · `` · variants: `primary` `secondary` `ghost` `link` `danger` `danger-outline` · sizes `sm` `md` `lg` · `loading` `fullWidth` `disabled` | | `Input` | Text, email, number, date, password inputs | ` setGpa(e.target.value)} error={errors.gpa} />` | | `Select` | Dropdowns | `

# Data model (demo data in the browser)

All data lives in one object (`db` from `useStore()`), one array per collection. The starting data is created by `src/data/seed.js`. Dates are ISO strings (`new Date().toISOString()`).

If you need a new collection (for example `assistantChats`), just `insert('assistantChats', row)`: it is created automatically.

## accounts
Login records for every role.
```js
{ id, role: 'student'|'company'|'admin', email, password, name,
  status: 'active'|'unverified'|'pending'|'rejected'|'suspended',
  rejectReason, suspendReason, failedAttempts, lockedUntil, createdAt, lastLoginAt }
```
`id` is the same as the student / company record id.

## students
```js
{ id, name, email, phone, university, major, academicLevel, graduationDate, gpa, gpaScale: 4|5,
  skills: [], preferredCities: [], preferredTypes: [], bio,
  resume: null | { fileName, dataUrl /* null = use /sample-resume.pdf */, uploadedAt, status: 'analysed'|'pending'|'unreadable' },
  notifyStatusUpdates: true, createdAt }
```

## companies
```js
{ id, name, crNumber, industry, city, email, contactPerson, phone, website, description, size,
  logo /* data URL or null */, submittedAt }
```
Approval status is on the matching **account** (`status: 'pending' | 'active' | 'rejected' | 'suspended'`).

## listings
Postings by companies (`source: 'internal'`) and imported ones (`source: 'external'`).
```js
{ id, source: 'internal'|'external', companyId /* internal */, companyName /* external */, externalUrl /* external */,
  title, summary, description, responsibilities: [], requirements: [], skills: [],
  trainingType, majors: [], academicLevels: [], city, workMode, durationWeeks,
  startDate, deadline, openings, paid: true|false, stipend: null|number,
  screeningQuestions: [{ id, text, type: 'text'|'yesno', required }],
  status: 'open'|'closed'|'removed', removedReason,
  postedAt, shortlistApprovedAt, finalizedAt }
```

## applications
Applications made through InternConnect.
```js
{ id, listingId, studentId, status /* APP_STATUS */, appliedAt,
  answers: { [questionId]: 'Yes' | 'No' | 'text' },
  history: [{ status, at, note }], external: false, archived /* optional, set when the student is suspended */ }
```
A student can apply only once per posting (even after withdrawing).

## externalApplications
Applications the student made on other websites and records by hand (FR-S9). Never updated automatically.
```js
{ id, studentId, company, title, link, appliedAt, status /* APP_STATUS */, notes, fromListingId /* or null */, history: [] }
```

## saved
```js
{ id, studentId, listingId, savedAt, reminder: true|false, reminderSentFor /* set by the reminder job */ }
```

## notifications
```js
{ id, userId, type: 'status'|'reminder'|'system', title, message, link /* a PATHS url or null */, read, createdAt }
```

## shortlistTables
Company shortlist tables (FR-C7). `applicationIds` hold application ids (not student ids).
```js
{ id, listingId, name, applicationIds: [], isShortlist: true|false, createdBy: 'company'|'assistant', createdAt,
  columns /* optional: which columns to show */, sortBy /* optional */ }
```

## assistantChats
Created by the shortlist assistant. Starts empty.
```js
{ id /* = listingId */, listingId, messages: [{ id, from: 'company'|'assistant', text, at, changes: [{ id, label, undo }] }] }
```
(`undo` should be data you can use to reverse the change, not a function, because the store is saved as JSON.)

## importedListings
Listings fetched from the external job API, waiting for admin review (FR-AD4).
```js
{ id, title, companyName, city, trainingType, majors: [], startDate, deadline, externalUrl, importedAt,
  status: 'new'|'published'|'rejected', duplicateOf /* listing id or null */ }
```

## externalSources
```js
{ id, name, status: 'enabled'|'disabled'|'error', lastSyncAt, imported, lastError, lastErrorAt }
```

## auditLog
```js
{ id, action, by, details, at }
```

## passwordResets
Used by the forgot-password flow only.
```js
{ id /* token */, accountId, expiresAt, used }
```

# Data model (demo data in the browser)

All data lives in one object (`db` from `useStore()`), one array per collection. The starting data is created by `src/data/seed.js`. Dates are ISO strings (`new Date().toISOString()`).

If you need a new collection (for example `assistantChats`), just `insert('assistantChats', row)`: it is created automatically.

## accounts
Login records for every role.
```js
{ id, role: 'student'|'company'|'admin', email, password, name,
  status: 'active'|'unverified'|'pending'|'rejected'|'suspended',
  rejectReason, suspendReason, failedAttempts, lockedUntil, createdAt, lastLoginAt }
```
`id` is the same as the student / company record id.

## students
```js
{ id, name, email, phone, university, major, academicLevel, graduationDate, gpa, gpaScale: 4|5,
  skills: [], preferredCities: [], preferredTypes: [], bio,
  resume: null | { fileName, dataUrl /* null = use /sample-resume.pdf */, uploadedAt, status: 'analysed'|'pending'|'unreadable' },
  notifyStatusUpdates: true, createdAt }
```

## companies
```js
{ id, name, crNumber, industry, city, email, contactPerson, phone, website, description, size,
  logo /* data URL or null */, submittedAt }
```
Approval status is on the matching **account** (`status: 'pending' | 'active' | 'rejected' | 'suspended'`).

## listings
Postings by companies (`source: 'internal'`) and imported ones (`source: 'external'`).
```js
{ id, source: 'internal'|'external', companyId /* internal */, companyName /* external */, externalUrl /* external */,
  title, summary, description, responsibilities: [], requirements: [], skills: [],
  trainingType, majors: [], academicLevels: [], city, workMode, durationWeeks,
  startDate, deadline, openings, paid: true|false, stipend: null|number,
  screeningQuestions: [{ id, text, type: 'text'|'yesno', required }],
  status: 'open'|'closed'|'removed', removedReason,
  postedAt, shortlistApprovedAt, finalizedAt }
```

## applications
Applications made through InternConnect.
```js
{ id, listingId, studentId, status /* APP_STATUS */, appliedAt,
  answers: { [questionId]: 'Yes' | 'No' | 'text' },
  history: [{ status, at, note }], external: false, archived /* optional, set when the student is suspended */ }
```
A student can apply only once per posting (even after withdrawing).

## externalApplications
Applications the student made on other websites and records by hand (FR-S9). Never updated automatically.
```js
{ id, studentId, company, title, link, appliedAt, status /* APP_STATUS */, notes, fromListingId /* or null */, history: [] }
```

## saved
```js
{ id, studentId, listingId, savedAt, reminder: true|false, reminderSentFor /* set by the reminder job */ }
```

## notifications
```js
{ id, userId, type: 'status'|'reminder'|'system', title, message, link /* a PATHS url or null */, read, createdAt }
```

## shortlistTables
Company shortlist tables (FR-C7). `applicationIds` hold application ids (not student ids).
```js
{ id, listingId, name, applicationIds: [], isShortlist: true|false, createdBy: 'company'|'assistant', createdAt,
  columns /* optional: which columns to show */, sortBy /* optional */ }
```

## assistantChats
Created by the shortlist assistant. Starts empty.
```js
{ id /* = listingId */, listingId, messages: [{ id, from: 'company'|'assistant', text, at, changes: [{ id, label, undo }] }] }
```
(`undo` should be data you can use to reverse the change, not a function, because the store is saved as JSON.)

## importedListings
Listings fetched from the external job API, waiting for admin review (FR-AD4).
```js
{ id, title, companyName, city, trainingType, majors: [], startDate, deadline, externalUrl, importedAt,
  status: 'new'|'published'|'rejected', duplicateOf /* listing id or null */ }
```

## externalSources
```js
{ id, name, status: 'enabled'|'disabled'|'error', lastSyncAt, imported, lastError, lastErrorAt }
```

## auditLog
```js
{ id, action, by, details, at }
```

## passwordResets
Used by the forgot-password flow only.
```js
{ id /* token */, accountId, expiresAt, used }
```

input.content:
# RESPONSIBILITIES - Asim Asiri (`asim` branch)

**Your part:** all **student** screens (Phase 3 screens 6-12 + the notifications page).
**Requirements you cover:** FR-S1 to FR-S10, FR-AI1 (simulated), FR-AI2, FR-AI5 (student side), FR-AI6 (search page), FR-A5 (log out in settings).

Read this whole file once before you start. If anything here is unclear, ask Musa **before** guessing.

---

## 0. Setup (do this once)

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd SWE363_Project_Phase4_Frontend
git checkout asim
git config user.name "Asim Asiri"          # your GitHub name
git config user.email "<your GitHub email>" # the email on your GitHub account
npm install
npm run dev                                 # open http://localhost:5173
```

Log in with the demo student: **nora@iau.edu.sa / Student123** (button on the login page). Every page you build is already reachable from the navbar; right now it shows "This screen is being built".

Before you start each day: `git pull origin main` (gets Musa's latest shared code).

## 1. Golden rules (these keep us free of merge conflicts)

**You may create and edit ONLY these:**

```
src/features/student/**          (everything inside, including new files and folders)
AI_USAGE.md                      (ONLY the line under "### Asim Asiri")
```

**Never edit** anything else - not `src/components`, `src/store`, `src/lib`, `src/hooks`, `src/context`, `src/routes`, `src/data`, `src/index.css`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `README.md`, and not the other members' folders. Don't run `npm install <something>`.

- Your pages already exist as placeholder files and are already registered in `AppRoutes.jsx`. You **replace the content** of each placeholder file. Keep the file name and the `export default function <Name>()` name exactly as they are.
- New helpers / components you need go in `src/features/student/components/` or `src/features/student/utils/`.
- If you think a shared file needs a change, message Musa with what and why. He changes it on `main`, you `git pull origin main`.

## 2. Design reference

- **Figma Make prototype:** https://www.figma.com/make/Kq6KXCPbxBB8ZD8cK04Jdz/InternConnect-Desktop-Prototype → click **Student flow**. Match these screens as closely as you can (spacing, sizes, texts, order of sections).
- **Annotated wireframes:** https://www.figma.com/design/TTgWHwlEfcfQgtLAXtT716/InternConnect---Phase-3-Annotated-Wireframes?node-id=0-1 → boards 6-12 have the notes for each state.
- The prototype has grey "PROTOTYPE STATES" / "RESULTS STATES" bars with buttons to switch states. **Do not copy those bars.** In our app the states must come from the real data (e.g. "no results" appears when the filters really return nothing).
- Look at the pages Musa already built (`src/features/guest/pages/LandingPage.jsx`, `ListingDetailPage.jsx`) - copy their patterns.

## 3. Tools you will use

Everything is documented with examples in **`docs/TOOLBOX.md`** (components, hooks, store, helpers) and **`docs/DATA_MODEL.md`** (fields of every collection). The most important for you:

| Need | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Logged-in student | `const { user, profile } = useAuth()` → `profile` is the student record, `user.id` is the studentId |
| Read data | `const { db } = useStore()` → `db.listings`, `db.applications`, `db.saved`, `db.externalApplications`, `db.notifications` |
| Change data | `insert`, `update`, `remove`, `transaction` from `useStore()` |
| Change an application's status | `transaction((db) => setApplicationStatus(db, [id], APP_STATUS.WITHDRAWN, 'Withdrawn by student'))` (from `store/actions`) |
| Notify a company | `addNotification(db, { userId: listing.companyId, ... })` inside `transaction` |
| Save / unsave + reminder switch | `useSavedListings()` |
| Notifications | `useNotifications()` |
| Search + filters | `searchListings()`, `useListingFilters('best')`, `FilterBar`, `SORT_OPTIONS`, `EMPTY_FILTERS` |
| Recommendations | `recommendListings(profile, getOpenListings(db), { excludeIds, limit: RULES.MAX_RECOMMENDATIONS })` → `[{ listing, label }]` |
| AI down? | `const { aiAvailable } = useAiStatus()` (footer switch "Simulate AI outage") |
| Messages | `const toast = useToast()` → `toast.success('Profile saved.')` |
| URLs | `PATHS.student.*`, `PATHS.listing(id)` |

Demo data you will see as Nora: applications in **every status** (Under Review, Short-Listed, Applied, Accepted, Withdrawn), 2 external applications, 4 saved listings (one closes in 2 days, one removed), 3 notifications. Use **Reset demo data** in the footer whenever you want the original data back.

---

## 4. Screens

For every screen: call `useDocumentTitle('<title>')`, start with `<PageHeader eyebrow="Student workspace" title=... subtitle=... />`, and make sure every action shows a toast.

### 4.1 Dashboard - `src/features/student/pages/StudentDashboardPage.jsx`
Route `/student` · FR-S3, FR-AI2, FR-AI5 · Prototype: Student flow → Dashboard

Layout (top to bottom, like the prototype):
1. `PageHeader` eyebrow "Student workspace", title `${greeting()}, ${firstName}` (use `greeting()` from `lib/format`), subtitle "Here's what's happening with your internship search."
2. **Profile completion banner** (dark `bg-night` card): a circular percentage, title "Complete your profile to improve your matches", a progress bar, "N of 5 sections complete", button **Complete profile** → `PATHS.student.profile`. Only show it while completion < 100%. Calculate completion in a helper `src/features/student/utils/profileCompletion.js` from 5 sections: personal (name + phone + bio), academic (university + major + academicLevel + graduationDate), skills (≥1), preferences (≥1 city and ≥1 type), resume (not null). The profile page uses the same helper.
3. **Recommended for you** (title + "Based on your major, skills, and preferences", link "View all opportunities" → search). Grid of `ListingCard` with `matchLabel` and `showDeadline` and the bookmark (`useSavedListings`). Max 10, best first, from `recommendListings(...)`, excluding listings the student already applied to.
   States:
   - no resume (`profile.resume == null`) → card "Upload your resume to get recommendations" + button to profile.
   - resume analysis pending (`profile.resume.status === 'pending'`) → `Spinner` "We're analysing your resume" and show the newest open listings for the student's major instead (no labels).
   - recommendations still work when AI is down (they use stored data) - don't hide them when `aiAvailable` is false.
4. Two cards side by side (stack on mobile):
   - **Closing soon** ("Saved opportunities nearing their deadline", link "View saved"): saved listings that are still open, sorted by deadline, max 3, each row: avatar, title, company · city, deadline label in red when ≤ 3 days, chevron → listing detail.
   - **Recent applications** ("Your latest activity", link "View tracker"): latest 3 internal applications, row: avatar, title, company, `StatusBadge`, chevron → tracker.
   Empty rows: short text + link (e.g. "No applications yet").

### 4.2 My profile - `src/features/student/pages/StudentProfilePage.jsx`
Route `/student/profile` · FR-S1, FR-AI1 · Prototype: Dashboard → Complete profile ("Your profile")

Layout: `PageHeader` title "Your profile", subtitle "Keep your information current to get more relevant matches.", action **Save changes**. Left column: section links (Personal details, Academic information, Skills & interests, Resume - clicking scrolls to the section) and a **Profile strength** bar (same helper as the dashboard). Right column: one `Card` per section.

- **Personal details:** full name, email (read-only), phone, short bio (`Textarea maxLength={300}`).
- **Academic information:** university (`Select` `UNIVERSITIES`), academic level (`ACADEMIC_LEVELS`), major (`MAJORS`), expected graduation (`type="month"` input), GPA (number), GPA scale (Select 4.0 / 5.0).
- **Skills & interests:** skills as removable chips + "Add a skill" input + **Add** button (Enter also adds, no duplicates, ignore empty). Preferred cities (multi-select chips from `CITIES`), preferred training types (chips from `TRAINING_TYPES`).
- **Resume:** `FileUpload accept={['application/pdf']} maxSizeMB={RULES.RESUME_MAX_MB} typeError="Please upload a PDF under 5 MB."`. When a resume exists show a box with file name, "PDF · Uploaded <date>", status line, and a **Replace file** button.

Behaviour:
- Keep the form in local state; **Save changes** validates then `update('students', profile.id, form)` and `toast.success('Profile saved.')`. Also update the account name: `update('accounts', user.id, { name })`.
- Validation (errors next to fields): university, major and graduation date required; GPA `validateGpa(gpa, scale)` (0-4 or 0-5); phone optional but valid if entered (`validatePhone`).
- Resume upload (simulated FR-AI1):
  1. wrong type / too big → error from `FileUpload` (it shows the message itself).
  2. valid PDF → save `resume: { fileName, dataUrl, uploadedAt, status: 'pending' }` → show "Analysis pending" with a `Spinner`.
  3. after ~2.5 seconds (`setTimeout`) set `status: 'analysed'` → "Resume analysed" with a check icon, toast "Resume analysed. Your recommendations were refreshed."
  4. if the file name contains `scan` (e.g. `my_scan.pdf`), set `status: 'unreadable'` instead → `Alert tone="danger"` "We couldn't read your resume. Try a text-based PDF."
  5. if the AI is down (`!aiAvailable`), keep `pending` and show "Analysis pending - we'll analyse it when the service is back."
- If the browser can't store a big PDF, it still works (the store catches the error); don't worry about it.

### 4.3 Find opportunities - `src/features/student/pages/SearchPage.jsx`
Route `/student/search` · FR-S2, FR-S6, FR-AI6 · Prototype: Student flow → Find opportunities

Layout (prototype):
- `PageHeader` title "Find opportunities", subtitle "Explore training opportunities that fit your goals."
- White card: search input ("Search by role, company, or keyword") + **Sort by** select (`SORT_OPTIONS`: Best match, Newest, Closest deadline).
- Below: **left filter sidebar** (Filters + Clear all; Training type, City, Work mode, Duration selects; Major select; Compensation; Start date) and **right results list** ("N opportunities" on the left, "Updated today" on the right). Result cards in the prototype are **wide rows** (logo, company, title, city · duration, tags, deadline label, bookmark + View details). Build that row as `src/features/student/components/SearchResultRow.jsx`. (The shared `FilterBar` is horizontal; for the sidebar build your own `src/features/student/components/FilterSidebar.jsx` using the same `filters` object and `Select`/`Checkbox` components.) On mobile the sidebar goes above the results (or behind a "Filters" button that opens it).

Behaviour:
- `const { filters, setFilters, sort, setSort, clearAll } = useListingFilters('best')` (filters live in the URL).
- Results: `searchListings(getOpenListings(db), filters, { companyNameOf: (l) => companyNameOf(db, l), sort, scoreOf: (l) => scoreListing(profile, l) })`. Results update as you type (no submit button needed).
- Bookmark: `useSavedListings().toggleSave(id)`.
- External listings show the "External" badge (already in the data, `listing.source === 'external'`).

States:
- No results → `EmptyState` "No listings match your filters" + **Clear filters** button.
- Sort = Best match but no resume → small `Alert` "Upload your resume to sort by best match" (with link to profile) and sort by newest instead.
- AI down (`!aiAvailable`) and there is a search text → small note "Showing keyword results only" and **only keyword results**: use `keywordCount` from `searchListings` and show `results.slice(0, keywordCount)`.
- Never show match labels or percentages on this page (Phase 3 rule).

### 4.4 Apply - `src/features/student/pages/ApplyPage.jsx`
Route `/student/apply/:listingId` · FR-S4 · Prototype: listing → Apply now (the popup)

The prototype shows this as a popup on the listing page. In our app it is its own page (the listing page's **Apply now** button already navigates here). Make the page look like the popup: a centered white card (max width ~720px) with:
- eyebrow "Application", serif title = listing title, "Company · City".

The shortlist tables, assistant chat, export and finalize (FR-C7 to FR-C10) are **Raed's**, not yours.

Read this whole file once before you start. If anything here is unclear, ask Musa **before** guessing.

---

## 0. Setup (do this once)

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd SWE363_Project_Phase4_Frontend

Before you start each day: `git pull origin main`.

## 1. Golden rules (these keep us free of merge conflicts)

**You may create and edit ONLY these:**

```
src/features/company/pages/**        (all files in this folder)
src/features/company/components/**   (create it for your own components)
src/features/company/utils/**        (create it for your own helpers)
AI_USAGE.md                          (ONLY the line under "### Bahaa Najjar")
```

**Never edit** `src/features/company/shortlist/**` (that is Raed's folder), and never edit `src/components`, `src/store`, `src/lib`, `src/hooks`, `src/context`, `src/routes`, `src/data`, `src/index.css`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `README.md` or other members' folders. Don't run `npm install <something>`.

- Your pages already exist as placeholder files and are registered in `AppRoutes.jsx`. **Replace the content** of each file, keeping the file name and the `export default function <Name>()` name.
- `PostingFormPage.jsx` is used by **two** routes: `/company/postings/new` (no `listingId` param → create) and `/company/postings/:listingId/edit` (edit).
- If a shared file needs a change, message Musa. He changes it on `main`, you `git pull origin main`.

## 2. Design reference

- **Figma Make prototype:** https://www.figma.com/make/Kq6KXCPbxBB8ZD8cK04Jdz/InternConnect-Desktop-Prototype → **Company flow**. Match it as closely as you can.
- **Annotated wireframes:** https://www.figma.com/design/TTgWHwlEfcfQgtLAXtT716/InternConnect---Phase-3-Annotated-Wireframes?node-id=0-1 → boards 13-16 and 18.
- Ignore the grey "PROTOTYPE STATES" bars in the prototype. In our app states come from real data.
- Copy patterns from Musa's pages (`src/features/guest/pages/*`, `src/features/auth/pages/*`).

## 3. Tools you will use

All documented with examples in **`docs/TOOLBOX.md`** and **`docs/DATA_MODEL.md`**. The main ones:

| Need | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Logged-in company | `const { user, profile } = useAuth()` → `profile` is the company record, `user.id` is the companyId |
| This company's postings | `db.listings.filter((l) => l.companyId === user.id)` |
| Applications for a posting | `getApplicationsForListing(db, listingId)`, student with `getStudent(db, app.studentId)` |
| Close a posting | `transaction((db) => closePosting(db, listing.id, 'Closed by company'))` - moves Applied → Under Review and notifies (FR-C4, FR-SYS3) |
| Change data | `insert`, `update`, `remove`, `transaction` from `useStore()` |
| Messages | `toast.success('Posting published.')` |
| URLs | `PATHS.company.*`, `PATHS.listing(id)` |

Demo data as Aramco Digital: **Software Engineering Co-op** (open, closes in 2 days, 3 applicants, screening questions), **Data Engineering Intern** (open, 3 applicants), **AI Engineer Trainee** (closed, 10 Under Review + 1 Withdrawn → Raed's shortlist workspace), **Cybersecurity Summer Training** (closed, shortlist approved). Other companies own other postings, so check you only show **your** company's data.

---

## 4. Screens

Every page: `useDocumentTitle(...)`, `PageHeader` with eyebrow **"Company workspace"**, a toast for every action.

### 4.1 Dashboard - `src/features/company/pages/CompanyDashboardPage.jsx`
Route `/company` · Prototype: Company flow → Dashboard

1. `PageHeader` title `Welcome back, ${profile.name}`, subtitle "Here's an overview of your recruitment activity.", action **+ New posting** → `PATHS.company.newPosting`.
2. 4 `StatCard`s with icons (lucide `Briefcase`, `User`, `Clock`, `Check`): **Active postings** (status open), **Total applicants** (non-withdrawn applications to your postings), **Awaiting review** (status Under Review), **Short-Listed** (status Short-Listed). Small `note` lines like the prototype ("+1 this month" can be computed from `postedAt` in the last 30 days, or a simple text).
3. Two cards side by side:
   - **Recent applicants** ("New applications across your postings", link "View all applicants" → `PATHS.company.allApplicants`): latest 3-5 applications, row = round avatar with initials, student name, posting title, chevron → `PATHS.company.applicant(app.id)`.
   - **Posting performance** ("Applications received", link "Manage postings" → `PATHS.company.postings`): one horizontal bar per posting (teal bar, width relative to the max, number on the right). Simple `div`s are enough.
4. **Active postings** card ("Your currently published opportunities", link "View all postings"): the same table as the postings page (reuse your component, see 4.2) limited to your latest postings.

Empty company (no postings yet): `EmptyState` "You haven't posted any opportunities yet" + **+ New posting**.

### 4.2 My postings - `src/features/company/pages/PostingsPage.jsx`
Route `/company/postings` · FR-C3, FR-C4 · Prototype: Company flow → Listings

Layout (prototype "My postings"):
- `PageHeader` title "My postings", subtitle "Create and manage your training opportunities.", action **+ New posting**.
- `Tabs` with counts: **All**, **Open**, **Closed**, **Removed**.
- White card: search ("Search postings") + sort `Select` (Newest first, Deadline, Most applicants).
- `Table` columns: Posting (title, badges under it, "Type · City"), Status (`Badge`: Open = teal, Closed = neutral, Removed by admin = danger), Deadline, Applicants (`countActiveApplicants`), Short-listed (count or "—"), Actions.
- Put the table in `src/features/company/components/PostingsTable.jsx` so the dashboard can reuse it.

Badges under the title: **Shortlist approved** (teal, when `shortlistApprovedAt`), **Finalized** (`tone="dark"`, when `finalizedAt`).

Actions per row:
| Posting state | Buttons |
| --- | --- |
| Open | **Edit** → edit route · **Close** · **Applicants** → `PATHS.company.applicants(id)` |
| Closed | **Reopen** · **Applicants** (or **View shortlist** → `PATHS.company.shortlist(id)` when `shortlistApprovedAt` is set) |
| Removed by admin | **Edit** only, plus a red line under the title: "Removed by admin: <removedReason>" |

Close (FR-C4): `ConfirmDialog` "Close this posting?" message "It will stop accepting applications and leave search. Current applicants move to Under Review." → `transaction((db) => closePosting(db, listing.id, 'Closed by company'))`, toast "Posting closed."

Reopen (FR-C4): `Modal` "Reopen posting" with a **new deadline** date input (required, must be in the future, and before the start date - same rule as the form) → `update('listings', id, { status: POSTING_STATUS.OPEN, deadline })`, toast "Posting reopened." Note: applications stay in their current statuses.

Empty tab → short `EmptyState` (e.g. "No closed postings").

### 4.3 Posting form - `src/features/company/pages/PostingFormPage.jsx`
Routes `/company/postings/new` and `/company/postings/:listingId/edit` · FR-C2, FR-C3 · Prototype: Listings → + New posting ("Create a new posting")

Layout (prototype):
- `PageHeader` title "Create a new posting" (or "Edit posting"), subtitle "Provide clear details to attract the right students.", actions **Save draft** (secondary) and **Preview posting** (primary).
- Left: numbered steps list (1 Basic information, 2 Eligibility, 3 Opportunity details, 4 Screening questions) - clicking scrolls to the card.
- Right: one `Card` per section:
  1. **Basic information:** Posting title*, Training type* (`TRAINING_TYPES`), City* (`CITIES`), Work mode* (`WORK_MODES`), Duration* (select of weeks: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28 - show with `durationLabel`), Start date*, Application deadline*, Number of openings*.
  2. **Eligibility:** Eligible majors* (chips picker from `MAJORS`), Academic levels* (checkboxes from `ACADEMIC_LEVELS`).
  3. **Compensation & skills:** Paid / Unpaid radio, Monthly stipend (SAR, optional, only when Paid), Required skills (chips + "Add a skill").
  4. **Opportunity details:** Short summary (one line shown on cards), Description*, Responsibilities* (`Textarea`, "one per line" → save as array split by new lines), Requirements (same).
  5. **Screening questions** (optional): list of questions, each with text, type (`Short text` / `Yes / No`), Required checkbox, delete button; **+ Add question** (`id: makeId('q')`).

Validation (FR-C2, errors next to each field + toast "Please fix the highlighted fields."):
- all fields required except stipend, summary, requirements and screening questions
- deadline must be in the future **and before** the start date
- openings ≥ 1
- at least one major and one academic level
- each screening question needs text

Flow:
- **Preview posting** → validate → show a preview (a `Modal` size `lg`, or a preview mode on the page) that looks like the public listing page: title, company, meta, about, what you'll do, requirements, overview. Buttons **Back to edit** and **Publish** (or **Save changes** when editing).
- **Publish (new):** `insert('listings', { ...form, id: makeId('l'), source: LISTING_SOURCE.INTERNAL, companyId: user.id, status: POSTING_STATUS.OPEN, postedAt: now, removedReason: '', shortlistApprovedAt: null, finalizedAt: null, companyName: null, externalUrl: null })` → toast "Posting published." → navigate to `PATHS.company.postings`. It appears in search immediately.
- **Save changes (edit):** `update('listings', id, form)` → toast "Posting updated." If the posting was **removed by admin**, saving does not reopen it (only admin can).
- **Save draft:** keep it simple: save the form to `localStorage` under `internconnect-posting-draft-<companyId>` and load it back when opening the new posting form (offer "Continue your draft?"). Toast "Draft saved."
- **Edit rules (FR-C3):** load the existing values; if the posting already has at least one application, the screening questions section is **locked** (read-only, with the note "Screening questions can't be changed after the first application."). A new deadline must be in the future.
- Editing someone else's posting or an unknown id → `EmptyState` "Posting not found".

### 4.4 Company profile - `src/features/company/pages/CompanyProfilePage.jsx`
Route `/company/profile` · FR-C1 · Prototype: Company flow → Profile

- `PageHeader` title "Company profile", subtitle "This is what students see on your listings.", action **Save changes**.
- **Logo:** current logo (`Avatar src={logo} name={name} size="lg"`) + `FileUpload accept={['image/png','image/jpeg']} maxSizeMB={RULES.LOGO_MAX_MB} typeError="Logo must be a PNG or JPG under 2 MB."` + **Remove logo**.
- **Company details:** Company name and CR number shown **read-only** with the note "Only an admin can change these." Industry (`INDUSTRIES`), City (`CITIES`), Company size (text), Website (`validateUrl`), Description (`Textarea maxLength={600}`).
- **Contact details:** contact person*, official email (read-only), phone* (`validatePhone`).
- Save → `update('companies', profile.id, form)`, toast "Profile saved."
- A small preview card on the right: "How students see you" (logo, name, industry · size, description) - optional but nice.

### 4.5 Applicants (all postings) - `src/features/company/pages/AllApplicantsPage.jsx`
Route `/company/applicants` (navbar "Applicants")

- `PageHeader` title "Applicants", subtitle "Applications across all your postings."
- One card per posting of yours (open first, then closed): title, status badge, deadline, counts per status (Applied / Under Review / Short-Listed / Accepted / Rejected / Withdrawn as small badges), button **View applicants** → `PATHS.company.applicants(listing.id)`.
- Optional: a search box over student names that lists matching applications with links to their detail page.
- No postings → `EmptyState` + **+ New posting**.

### 4.6 Applicants of one posting - `src/features/company/pages/ApplicantsPage.jsx`
Route `/company/postings/:listingId/applicants` · FR-C5 · Prototype: postings → Applicants (screen 16)

**This screen is shared with Raed. Read carefully.** The placeholder file already contains the split logic - keep it:

```jsx
const workspaceMode = listing?.status === POSTING_STATUS.CLOSED && !listing?.shortlistApprovedAt
...
{/* your header always */}
{!workspaceMode && <YourApplicantsList ... />}
{listing && <ShortlistWorkspace listing={listing} applications={applications} />}
```

- `applications` must be **all** applications of this posting, each joined with its student: `getApplicationsForListing(db, listingId).map((app) => ({ ...app, student: getStudent(db, app.studentId) }))`.
- `ShortlistWorkspace` is imported from `'../shortlist/ShortlistWorkspace'` - **don't edit that file**, it is Raed's. When the posting is closed and not shortlisted yet, Raed's component shows the whole workspace (its own applicants table with checkboxes, the tables and the chat), so your list is hidden in that case.

What you build:
- Header (always): eyebrow "Company workspace", serif title = posting title, line "N applicants · M openings", link "← Back to My postings" → `PATHS.company.postings`, posting status badge.
- **Applicants list** (when not in workspace mode): `Card` titled "Applicants" with
  - status `Tabs` (All + each status that exists, with counts) or a status `Select`,
  - sort `Select`: Date applied (newest first, default) / Name (A-Z),
  - `Table` columns: Name (round `Avatar` + name), University, Major, Date applied, Status (`StatusBadge`), chevron. Clicking a row → `PATHS.company.applicant(app.id)`.
  - **Withdrawn** rows are greyed out (`opacity-50`) and not clickable (FR-C5).
  - Hide applications with `archived: true` (suspended students).
- No applications → `EmptyState` "No applicants yet."
- Wrong id / another company's posting → `EmptyState` "Posting not found" (NFR-6: a company sees only its own applicants).
- **Never show match labels or scores to companies** (Phase 3 rule).

### 4.7 Applicant detail - `src/features/company/pages/ApplicantDetailPage.jsx`
Route `/company/applicants/:applicationId` · FR-C6 · Prototype: click an applicant (screen 18)

Layout (prototype):
- `PageHeader` title = student name, subtitle "Applicant for <posting title>", action **Back to applicants** → `PATHS.company.applicants(listing.id)`.
- Left card: round avatar, name, university, major, academic level, expected graduation, GPA ("3.8 / 4.0"), preferred cities, skills as teal chips, and email / phone.
- Right column:
  - **Screening answers** card: "Submitted <date>", each question text (bold) + the answer. If the posting has no questions: "This posting had no screening questions."
  - **Resume** card: file name + **Download PDF** button (`<a href={src} download={fileName}>`), and a viewer: `<iframe src={src} title="Resume" className="h-[640px] w-full rounded-lg border border-line" />` where `src = student.resume?.dataUrl ?? '/sample-resume.pdf'`. No resume → "No resume uploaded."
  - **Status history** (small timeline from `application.history`) - optional.
- Current status shown as a `StatusBadge` near the title. **Opening this page never changes the status** (FR-C6). There are no status buttons here (statuses change only through Raed's shortlist steps).
- Withdrawn application → `Alert tone="warning"` "This applicant withdrew their application." at the top (still viewable, read-only).
- Access check: if the application's posting isn't this company's → `EmptyState` "Applicant not found".

---

## 5. Responsive checklist

Check every page at **390px** (Chrome DevTools device toolbar) and **1440px**:
- [ ] no sideways scrolling of the page (tables scroll inside their card - the `Table` component does it)
- [ ] the form's step list is hidden or moves above the form on mobile; form grids become one column
- [ ] dashboard cards stack on mobile
- [ ] action buttons in tables wrap or shrink nicely

## 6. Suggested commits (small, in your own words)

1. `postings table component`
2. `company dashboard`
3. `my postings page with tabs, close and reopen`
4. `posting form basic info and eligibility`
5. `posting form details, skills and screening questions`
6. `posting preview, publish and edit`
7. `company profile page`
8. `all applicants overview`
9. `applicants list for a posting`
10. `applicant detail with resume viewer`
11. `mobile fixes for company pages`
12. `ai usage note for company pages`

Commit only your files: `git add src/features/company/pages src/features/company/components src/features/company/utils AI_USAGE.md`. Never `git add .`.

## 7. Pull request checklist

Push: `git push origin bahaa`. GitHub → **Pull requests → New → base: main, compare: bahaa**. Title "Company screens". Paste and tick:

- [ ] I only changed `src/features/company/pages|components|utils` and my line in `AI_USAGE.md` (nothing in `shortlist/`)
- [ ] `npm run lint` shows no errors and `npm run build` works
- [ ] Dashboard: stats, recent applicants, posting performance, active postings
- [ ] Postings: tabs with counts, search, sort, close (applicants move to Under Review), reopen with new deadline, removed-by-admin reason
- [ ] Posting form: all fields + validation, screening questions, preview, publish (appears in search), edit, locked questions after first application, draft
- [ ] Company profile: logo upload (wrong file error), read-only name/CR, website validation, save
- [ ] All applicants overview
- [ ] Applicants list: status filter, sort, withdrawn greyed, row → detail, `ShortlistWorkspace` kept with the split logic
- [ ] Applicant detail: profile, answers, resume viewer + download, withdrawn alert, status never changes
- [ ] Only my company's data is shown anywhere
- [ ] Every page checked at 390px and 1440px

## 8. AI usage

If you use any AI tool (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Cursor, even autocomplete), replace **only** the line `_To be completed by Bahaa ..._` in `AI_USAGE.md` with the tools, what you used them for, and the files affected. If you didn't use any, write "I did not use any AI tools." Keep copies of your AI conversations for the AI Evidence zip. You must be able to explain every line you commit.

| "Why is Reem in Strong ML background?" | answer with the reason sentence (4.4) |
